scope: Posthoc observation only; no optimization or checkpoint changes

definition.q_scale_definition: sqrt(mean over q dimensions of variance across all test anchor q))
definition.p_scale_definition: RMS across dimensions and all test anchor p
definition.p_activity: RMS over following 1s and dimensions / p_scale
definition.reference_active: same 1s window: omega RMS >0.1rad/s AND max circular angle excursion >0.01rad
definition.disclaimer: Thresholds0.001/0.01/0.05 are descriptive sensitivity checks, not externally calibrated pass/fail criteria; normalization uses test anchors, no model fitting
definition.kinetic_potential: K=0.5||p||^2; V=H-K, consistent with fixed M=I implementation

teacher.scope: 44 metadata-selected trajectories, true future image histories re-encoded; diagnostic only

renderer_zero_discontinuity.interpretation: Rasterization has a discontinuity at zero angle. Establishes a possible source of noisy latent derivatives, not by itself the cause of the learned stall.
